title: Feature: Project artifacts standard
hero: How every project gets the same status artifacts: a feature artifact per feature and one full-progress artifact for all the work, kept current automatically. Built in dev-standards as the plugin luismc-artifacts.
lede: luismc-artifacts 1.0.0 is live (AR12, #18), and these artifacts are now kept with it (AR17). Every task here is also on Full Progress: dev-standards.
